text:
ConocoPhillips jumped 2.67% today to $154, capping a strong two-week rally of over 5%. The move follows news that Qatari mediators held extensive talks in Tehran aimed at restarting U.S.-Iran negotiations, raising hopes for de-escalation in the Middle East. Oil prices have climbed sharply—U.S. crude hit $103.37 per barrel and global crude is at $123.10—reflecting geopolitical risk premium as the market prices in uncertainty around Iranian tensions and potential supply disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz.

Oil majors like ConocoPhillips also benefit when crude prices rise and refining margins expand, which recent reporting suggests has happened as fuel supplies tightened. Even as the Trump administration has criticized Big Oil's profits, surging refining earnings have offset political pressure, keeping energy stocks attractive to investors.
